questions.statement: Which word in English names the person who teaches students in a school?
questions.context: In a school in Medellin, a visitor shows pictures of people who help the community.

options.text: Teacher.
options.feedback: A teacher works in a school and helps students learn new things.

options.text: Doctor.
options.feedback: A doctor takes care of sick people in a hospital or clinic.

options.text: Driver.
options.feedback: A driver moves people or goods in a bus, a taxi, or a truck.

options.text: Farmer.
options.feedback: A farmer works in the field and grows food for the community.

questions.explanation: Identifying basic occupations by their main function in English (teacher, doctor, driver, farmer). / Identificar oficios basicos segun su funcion en ingles.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Read: "Mr. Gomez is a farmer. He gets up very early and works in the field near Ibague."

options.text: He grows food in the field every day.
options.feedback: The text says Mr. Gomez is a farmer who works in the field.

options.text: He drives a bus in the city.
options.feedback: Driving a bus is the work of a driver, not a farmer.

options.text: He sells medicine in a pharmacy.
options.feedback: Selling medicine is not mentioned and is not the farmer's work.

options.text: He helps sick people in a hospital.
options.feedback: Helping sick people is the work of a doctor or a nurse.

questions.explanation: Understanding what a person does from a short descriptive text in English. / Comprender la funcion de una persona a partir de un texto corto.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence correctly uses the verb "work" with the third person singular?
questions.context: A student talks about her mother: "My mother is a doctor. She works in a hospital in Cali."

options.text: She works in a hospital.
options.feedback: "Works" adds -s to agree with the third person singular subject "she".

options.text: She work in a hospital.
options.feedback: "Work" without -s is incorrect with "she" in Simple Present.

options.text: She working in a hospital.
options.feedback: "Working" is a gerund and needs an auxiliary verb here.

options.text: She is work in a hospital.
options.feedback: "Is" cannot be followed by the base form "work" in this sentence.

questions.explanation: Using the Simple Present with the third person singular to describe jobs in English. / Usar el presente simple en tercera persona para describir oficios.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which question correctly matches this answer about a job?
questions.context: A police officer in Bucaramanga says: "I help people and take care of the streets in my city."

options.text: What does a police officer do?
options.feedback: The answer describes the actions of a police officer, so this question fits.

options.text: How old is a police officer?
options.feedback: The answer does not give an age, so this question does not match.

options.text: Where does a police officer live?
options.feedback: The answer does not mention a home or an address.

options.text: What color is the police officer's car?
options.feedback: The answer does not talk about the color of any car.

questions.explanation: Matching questions with answers about occupations in English. / Relacionar preguntas con respuestas sobre oficios.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct sentence that describes what a bus driver does.
questions.context: A bus driver in Barranquilla says: "I start work at five in the morning and I drive students to school."

options.text: A bus driver drives people from one place to another.
options.feedback: Driving people from one place to another is the main action of a bus driver.

options.text: A bus driver teaches children to read.
options.feedback: Teaching children is the work of a teacher, not a driver.

options.text: A bus driver grows vegetables in the field.
options.feedback: Growing vegetables is the work of a farmer, not a driver.

options.text: A bus driver helps sick animals.
options.feedback: Helping sick animals is the work of a veterinarian, not a driver.

questions.explanation: Describing the main action of a job with a simple sentence in English. / Describir la accion principal de un oficio con una oracion simple.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which occupation does Mr. Rojas have?
questions.context: Read: "When Diana has a bad tooth, she goes to see Mr. Rojas. He looks at her teeth and helps her feel better."

options.text: He is a dentist.
options.feedback: Looking at teeth and helping them feel better is the work of a dentist.

options.text: He is a teacher.
options.feedback: A teacher works with students in a school, not with teeth.

options.text: He is a farmer.
options.feedback: A farmer works in the field with plants and animals.

options.text: He is a police officer.
options.feedback: A police officer takes care of people and streets, not teeth.

questions.explanation: Inferring a person's occupation from clues in a short text in English. / Inferir el oficio de una persona a partir de pistas en un texto corto.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which comparison correctly explains how these two helpers are similar?
questions.context: Compare two helpers: "The doctor helps people who are sick, and the teacher helps children learn. Both work to help the community."

options.text: Both the doctor and the teacher help people in the community.
options.feedback: The text says both helpers work to help the community.

options.text: Both the doctor and the teacher grow food in the field.
options.feedback: Growing food is the work of a farmer, not of these two helpers.

options.text: The doctor teaches children and the teacher gives medicine.
options.feedback: The text says the opposite of these two roles.

options.text: Neither the doctor nor the teacher works in the community.
options.feedback: The text says both of them help the community.

questions.explanation: Comparing two occupations in English to find what they have in common. / Comparar dos oficios en ingles para hallar lo que tienen en comun.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What is the most important message of this paragraph?
questions.context: Read: 'Many people work in a city every day. Doctors, teachers, police officers, drivers, and farmers do different jobs, but all of them help the community in different ways.'

options.text: Different jobs help the community in different ways.
options.feedback: The text lists several jobs and says all of them help the community.

options.text: Only doctors are important in a city.
options.feedback: The text mentions many jobs, not only doctors.

options.text: Farmers do not help the community.
options.feedback: The text includes farmers among the people who help the community.

options.text: All people in a city have the same job.
options.feedback: The text says people do different jobs, not the same one.

questions.explanation: Evaluating the main message of a short expository paragraph about jobs and community helpers. / Evaluar el mensaje principal de un parrafo sobre oficios y ayudantes de la comunidad.
questions.subject: ingles
